server:
  name: srv2
  deploy_domain: deploy.example.com
  stacks_dir: /opt/deploy
  github_token: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}

apps:
  budget:
    repo: nogo/budget-app
    branch: main
    domain: budget.example.com
    env_file: .env.budget
    compose: compose.yml
    override: |
      services:
        app:
          volumes:
            - /srv/budget/data:/data
    secrets:
      - key: budget/db_password
        type: env
        target: DB_PASSWORD
    preview:
      enabled: false
      domain: "*.preview.example.com"

  tracker:
    repo: nogo/budget-app
    branch: main
    domain: tracker.example.com
    env_file: .env.tracker
    override: |
      services:
        app:
          volumes:
            - /srv/tracker/data:/data

stacks:
  nextcloud:
    path: stacks/nextcloud
    domain: cloud.example.com
    auto_deploy: false
    update_script: stacks/nextcloud/update.sh

  ghost:
    path: stacks/ghost
    domain: blog.example.com
    auto_deploy: false
    update_script: stacks/ghost/update.sh
